arguments.description: Architectural variant B of this living-tree hall: split the massive trunk into two unequal ancient trunks supporting a long asymmetrical suspended ceremonial gallery between them. Add a tall left lookout and a low right leaf-roof chamber, a central carved entrance and visible wraparound stairs. Clearly change massing and roof arrangement, preserving the exact pixel density, forest palette, upper-left lighting, shallow three-quarter camera and transparent background. No scenery or ground shadow.
